name: Pfrillsee Kufstein
kurzbeschreibung: Pfrillsee near Kufstein is the highest and warmest of Kufstein's four woodland lakes—a secluded moorland sanctuary with water lilies and peaceful loop trails.
preis: Free public access (hiker parking at Hechtsee approx. 3–5 €)
beschreibung:
Überblick

Lake Pfrillsee is the smallest, highest, and warmest among the four renowned woodland lakes surrounding the fortress town of Kufstein (alongside Hechtsee, Egelsee, and Längsee). Nestled peacefully at 615 metres elevation in a sheltered forest basin beneath the historic Thierberg hill, this pristine body of water covers roughly 1.7 hectares with a depth reaching eight metres. As a protected natural moorland lake, Pfrillsee is celebrated for its soft, dark, peat-rich water that warms rapidly under late spring sunshine, drawing nature lovers and wild swimmers seeking solace away from urban commotion. Encircled by dense mixed beech and spruce woodlands, lush reed beds, and white water lily colonies, it provides a quiet refuge supporting rare dragonflies, amphibians, and native waterfowl.

Route & Anforderungen

Exploring Pfrillsee offers pure tranquility suited to walkers of all fitness levels. A natural singletrack shoreline path loops around the lake in twenty to thirty minutes of gentle walking (distance approx. 1.2 km, easy grade T1). Timber boardwalks and clearing spots invite quiet contemplation or an invigorating dip in the soft moorland waters. Most hikers incorporate the lake into the classic Kufstein Four Lakes Circuit: starting from the main car park at Lake Hechtsee, a well-signposted woodland track climbs gently through shaded beech groves in roughly 45 minutes to reach Pfrillsee. Sturdy walking shoes with reliable tread are recommended during wet conditions due to exposed tree roots. Dogs must be kept on a leash along all shoreline paths.

Besuch & Anreise

Train connections arrive at Kufstein central station via mainline ÖBB and regional services. From town, local bus routes run towards Morsbach, or visitors can hike directly up from the town centre in about 45 minutes along signposted forest footpaths. Motorists take the Inntal autobahn A12 (exit Kufstein-Nord) and follow the Thiersee provincial road (L37) to the dedicated Hechtsee hiker car park. Public access to Pfrillsee is entirely free of charge year-round.

Tipps

Arrive in the early morning when ethereal mist ribbons drift over the glassy, dark surface reflecting the tall forest canopy—a dream setting for photographers. Combine your walk with a short climb to the nearby medieval Thierberg castle ruins and its panoramic lookout chapel.
saison: Ganzjährig frei zugänglich (Badesaison Juni bis September)
